name: aidlc-tracker-ado
description: The Azure DevOps MCP server for AIDLC's ADO work-item adapter. OPTIONAL: the wi-ado adapter's tier-2 `az boards`/`az rest` path covers every operation and is already what headless runs use, so ADO works without this — the server is a richer interactive tier, not a dependency. Needs ADO_MCP_ORG set in the shell that launches Claude Code. Ships nothing but the server; the adapter lives in core.
